apiRoutes.code:
// Author: Dr Hamid MADANI drmdh@msn.com
import { createClientsHandler } from '@mostajs/secu'
import { clientRepo, auditLogRepo } from '@/dal/service'
import { checkPermission } from '@/lib/authCheck'
import { logAudit, getAuditUser } from '@mostajs/audit'

export const { GET, POST } = createClientsHandler({
  checkAuth: (perm) => checkPermission(perm),
  getClientRepo: clientRepo,
  logAudit: async (entry) => { const repo = await auditLogRepo(); await logAudit(repo, entry) },
  getAuditUser,
})
